methods.documented_intro: The method allows you to download orders from a specific date from the Base order manager. The order list can be limited using the filters described in the method parameters. A maximum of 100 orders are returned at a time. It is recommended to download only confirmed orders (get_unconfirmed_orders = false). Unconfirmed orders may be incomplete. The user may be, for example, in the process of creating an order - it already exists in the database, but not all information is completed. Unconfirmed orders may contain only a partial list of products and may be changed soon. Confirmed orders usually do not change anymore and can be safely downloaded to an external system. The best way to download the ongoing orders is: Collecting new order identifiers using getJournalList. Or, using this method: 1. Setting the starting date and specifying it in the date_confirmed_from field 2. Processing of all received orders. If 100 orders are received, there may be even more to download. 3. Downloading the next package of orders by entering the value of the date_confirmed field from last downloaded order in the date_confirmed_from field. In order to avoid downloading the same orders value of date_confirmed should be increased by 1 second. This operation is repeated until you receive a package with less than 100 orders (this means that there are no more orders left to download). 4. Saving the date_confirmed last processed order. You can download orders from this date onwards so that you do not download the same order twice. It is not possible for an order to 'jump' into the database with an earlier confirmation date. This way you can be sure that all confirmed orders have been downloaded.
documented_notes_pl: Najwyżej100zamówień. Domyślnie tylko confirmed; unconfirmed mogą być niekompletne i zmieniać się, łącznie z listą pozycji/dostawą.

Dokument zaleca getJournalList lub date_confirmed_from od ostatniego wyniku plus1sekunda, aż partia<100. Nie podano osobnego stabilnego tie-breakera dla>=100potwierdzeń w tej samej sekundzie; nie zmieniamy zalecenia w bezwarunkową gwarancję bezstratności.
filter_order_source_id wymaga filter_order_source. filter_external_order_id nie powinno być łączone z filter_shop_order_id. IDźródła unikalne tylko wraz z order_source.
include_custom_extra_fields/commissions/connect_data/discounts_data i get_unconfirmed_orders domyślniefalse. order_source_info jest aktualnie niedostępne według opisu.
discounts mają order_lines_details zawierające te same pola poza order_lines_details, bez nieskończonego rozwijania schematu. profile_id=-1 oznacza API; order_product_id=0 dlaorder/shipmentdiscount.
getOrders ma inne długości i typy części pól niż zapis; payment_method_cod/want_invoice są varchar1, variant_id varchar30, a nie bool/int zapisu. Odczyt nie definiuje jednostki weight.

methods.documented_intro: Merges multiple orders into one, based on the selected merge mode.
documented_notes_pl: main_order_id zachowuje dane wysyłki i faktury; order_ids_to_merge nie może zawierać main_order_id.
technical_merge tworzy nowe techniczne zamówienie bez zmiany oryginałów; into_main_order przenosi pozycje do głównego i usuwa pozostałe.
sum_delivery_costs true sumuje dostawy, false zachowuje wyłącznie dostawę głównego. Brak wartości domyślnej i pełnych reguł rounding/currency.
Nie podano limitu liczby zamówień, polityki duplikatów, statusów, różnic kupującego/walut/finansów/dokumentów/stock/WMS, wersji, readback per źródło, atomowości lub recovery.

parameters.name: main_order_id
parameters.documented_description: ID of the main order (its shipping and invoice data will be retained).

parameters.name: order_ids_to_merge
parameters.documented_description: List of other order IDs to merge. Must not include main_order_id.

parameters.name: merge_mode
parameters.documented_description: Merge mode: technical_merge (creates a new technical order without changing the originals) or into_main_order (moves items into the main order and deletes the others).

parameters.name: sum_delivery_costs
parameters.documented_description: Whether to sum delivery costs: true (add up all shipping costs from merged orders) or false (keep only the main order's shipping cost).

fields.documented_description: SUCCESS - request executed correctlyERROR - an error occurred during an API request. Error details will be described in 2 additional returned fields: error_message and error_code
ID of the merged order
